Hi Marissa,

Thanks again — contract is signed (attached). The exec team wants the Mutual Action Plan to include an explicit, time-bound activation orchestration: staging, canary migration, full cutover, and training for our ops and security teams. We also need acceptance criteria per phase and a hard go/no-go cadence aligned to our compliance gate.

High-level asks from our side:
- Kickoff week target: week of Aug 7 (we can shift if needed)
- Canary window must include rollback criteria and metrics we can validate
- Training: two sessions (ops + SRE) and a separate runbook handoff
- Evidence: SOC 2 artifacts, audit log retention plan, and encryption/KMS posture details

Subject: Re: Signed — proposed activation orchestration & MAP (draft)

Caroline — really excited to get started, congrats on the close. Attached is a draft MAP that embeds the post-signature activation orchestration you requested (Redwood_MAP_v1.0.pdf). Key callouts below and a suggested week-by-week cadence.

Summary (high level):
- Kickoff: Aug 7 (remote, 90min) — align owners, test accounts, and fallbacks
- Phase A (Staging): Aug 8–14 — integration checks, baseline performance, initial KV/prefix caching enabled
- Phase B (Canary Migration): Aug 15–28 — three staged traffic ramps (10% -> 40% -> 75%), automated rollback thresholds, 48h observation windows
- Phase C (Full Cutover): Aug 29 — target low-traffic cutover with hotfix contingency
- Training & Handoff: Sep 1–5 — two live workshops (Ops, SRE) + recorded runbook delivery
- Hypercare: Sep 6–20 — 24/7 on-call coverage for critical SLOs

Owners / primary contacts:
- Redwood PM & MAP lead: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com)
- Technical lead (serving/runtime): Jonas Weber (jonas@redwood.com)
- Migration ops & scheduling: Ben Carter (ben@redwood.com)
- Training & docs: Laura Bennett (laura@redwood.com)

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- Staging: successful key exchange, baseline latency within 1.5x of production profile, no PII exfiltration test failures
- Canary: error rate <0.5% for 48h at each ramp step, 95th percentile latency within agreed threshold, no increase in token cost >10% vs baseline

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.0.pdf (MAP with embedded timeline), canary-runbook.xlsx (playbook skeleton). I flagged the SOC 2 evidence we can provide in the MAP appendix; Jonas will follow up with specifics on logging and KMS.

If procurement needs different payment term language added to the MAP, we can annotate and send back. Keen to lock kickoff for Aug 7 — does that work for your team?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Marissa — thanks for the draft MAP. A couple of procurement/compliance items before kickoff:

1) Payment schedule: our finance team requires a 30-day invoice term for the first quarterly invoice. Please confirm this is acceptable and annotate the MAP with the invoice cadence.
2) SOC 2 artifacts: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II report and an inventory of audit logs and retention policies for inference requests (we will share a questionnaire).
3) Canary rollback: please add specific rollback thresholds (e.g., error-rate delta >0.3% or latency 95th increase >25% between baseline and ramp) and a short vendor escalation matrix for urgent rollbacks.

We may need to shift kickoff out one week if our budget committee requires additional sign-off — worst case, aim for Aug 14 kickoff. Please include DocuSign reference and HubSpot deal ID in your updated MAP so procurement can track.

Procurement Team
VerityHealth

On Wed, Aug 1, 2028 at 11:05 AM Procurement Team <procurement@verityhealth.io> wrote:
> Marissa — thanks for the draft MAP. A couple of procurement/compliance items before kickoff:
>
> 1) Payment schedule...
> 2) SOC 2 artifacts...
> 3) Canary rollback...

Thanks — added some operational specifics below to help the procurement/security review:

Proposed Canary ramping and rollback (operational):
- Step 1 (10% traffic) — baseline validation for 24h. Rollback if errors >0.5% or p95 latency >200ms over baseline for 30min window.
- Step 2 (40% traffic) — 48h observation. Rollback if sustained error-rate delta >0.3% or p95 latency >20% over baseline for 1hr.
- Step 3 (75% traffic) — 72h observation. If any sustained SLI breach (error-rate or latency) and automated mitigations fail, immediate rollback to prior stable step.

Metrics we will publish to Verity dashboards during canary: error rate, p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, model output quality (prompt-specific eval set pass rate). We will provide a live link to metrics during each ramp.

Action items assigned:
- Laura to schedule two training sessions (Ops + SRE) and prepare runbook handoff — ETA Aug 10 for calendar invites.
- Jonas to upload SOC 2 summary and KMS details to the MAP appendix — ETA Aug 4.
- Marissa to update MAP with payment term annotation and HubSpot + DocuSign references — ETA Aug 3.

Attaching operational canary runbook draft for review.

Ben Carter
Senior Technical Program Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
